videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Carrick says it's 'crazy' but he's looking forward to Roma game.
Under-pressure Michael Carrick says it might be "crazy" but he is looking forward to Manchester United's Champions League match against Roma at Old Trafford.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Fifa to share confidential World Cup sell-off plan documents.
Fifa has informed members of its Council that they will be granted access to view some documents related to president Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

To dive or not to dive? Football's big dilemma.
Liverpool feel Alexander Isak should have been awarded a penalty against Arsenal but with the striker not appealing for the decision and the VAR staying out of it, should he have made more of it?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Villa drop legal action threat against Carragher.
Aston Villa will not move forward with any legal action towards Jamie Carragher.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Bottom club Sunderland to stick with manager Le Bris.
Sunderland manager Regis le Bris is set to be given more time to turn things around despite his side's poor start to the Premier League season.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.title: Actualidad internacional
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Actualidad internacional.

Key questions as Pocognoli prepares to name Scotland squad.
Sebastien Pocognoli names his second Scotland squad on Tuesday, with various dilemmas to address.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

I'll tell my players to dive in future - Iraola.
Andoni Iraola says that he will tell his players to go down in future after Liverpool were denied a penalty in Sunday's defeat by Arsenal.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

No Grealish, no problem - the rise of Everton's youngsters.
BBC Sport examines the growing influence of Everton's youngsters on their chances of success this season.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Hellberg unsure of 'brilliant' Lankshear's England chances.
Head coach Kim Hellberg hails Will Lankshear a "brilliant lad" as the goals keep coming, raising questions of a possible England call-up.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool.
Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Últimas noticias del fútbol.

Trailing 8-0 & down to six players - abandoned game labelled a 'farce'.
A non-league game abandoned after one team was reduced to six players while trailing 8-0 is labelled "a complete farce".
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Every goal from the Women's Super League - matchweek eight.
Watch every goal from across the WSL in match week eight, from Chelsea's thrashing to Arsenal's late equaliser, in an eventful weekend of action.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Were Arsenal 'lucky' not to concede penalty at Liverpool?.
BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards discuss Liverpool's denied penalty claim for a pull on Alexander Isak's shirt by Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber and whether the Reds can feel hard done by.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Rice is a rounded midfielder, but could be more selfish - Murphy.
BBC Sport's Kelly Cates and Micah Richards discuss how rounded Declan Rice has become in Arsenal's midfield, while Danny Murphy argues that if he was more selfish he would score more goals.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

'He's been fantastic' - how Konsa has fitted in seamlessly at Arsenal.
BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards analyse how good Ezri Konsa has been for Arsenal after signing from Aston Villa in the summer, especially in their 1-0 Premier League win against Liverpool at Anfield.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
